lines.say: Trash's real money? The dump: five point three billion.

lines.text: In 2025, WM's trucks billed $17.6 billion and its landfills $5.3 billion, before internal sales.
lines.say: In twenty twenty-five, WM's trucks billed seventeen point six billion; its landfills, five point three.

lines.text: But every truck must dump somewhere, and dumps charge a tipping fee per ton.
lines.say: But every truck must dump somewhere, and dumps charge a tipping fee.

lines.text: The average US landfill tipping fee was $63.48 a ton in 2025 (EREF).
lines.say: In twenty twenty-five, the US average was sixty-three dollars and forty-eight cents a ton.

lines.text: Example: a 10-ton load x $63.48 = $634.80, just to unload.
lines.say: So a ten-ton load pays six hundred thirty-four dollars and eighty cents.

lines.text: The trick: haul it to your own dump and the fee stays in-house. That's internalization.
lines.say: The trick: haul it to your own dump, and the fee stays in-house. That's internalization.

lines.text: In 2025, WM internalized 69.4% of its waste (by disposal cost); Republic Services about 67% (by volume).
lines.say: In twenty twenty-five, WM did that with sixty-nine point four percent of its waste; Republic, about sixty-seven.

lines.text: At the end of 2025, WM ran 253 landfills with about 38 years of permitted space left.
lines.say: WM ran two hundred fifty-three landfills at the end of twenty twenty-five, with about thirty-eight years of space left.

lines.text: Anyone can buy a truck, but new landfill permits often take years, and neighbors often fight them.

post.title: Trash's real money is the dump: WM's $5.3B landfill business
post.ig:
The real money in trash is the dump.

In 2025, WM's landfills brought in $5.3B (gross, before internal sales), next to $17.6B from collection.
Every truck pays a tipping fee to unload: the US average was $63.48 a ton in 2025 (EREF). Example: 10 tons x $63.48 = $634.80.
Haul to your own landfill and that fee stays in-house: WM did it with 69.4% of its waste in 2025 (by disposal cost), Republic Services about 67% (by volume).
WM ran 253 landfills at the end of 2025, with about 38 years of permitted space; new permits often take years.

Sources: WM FY2025 10-K and Q4 2025 results; Republic Services FY2025 10-K; EREF 2025 tipping fee analysis.
